tools.name: find_cars
tools.description: Search new cars for lease or finance in California. Every car comes with its monthly payment before tax for the stated credit tier and a deal_url, a page where the buyer finishes personally.

tools.name: get_payment
tools.description: Calculate the exact monthly payment for one car the buyer has chosen, on the buyer's terms, with the same engine as hunter.lease. Returns the monthly payment before tax, term, miles per year, amount due at signing, money factor and residual (lease) or APR (finance), MSRP, selling price, incentives,

tools.name: how_to_buy
tools.description: What an assistant can do, what the buyer must do personally, the service fee, credit tiers and allowed terms. Use it at the start of a conversation about buying a car.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_cars" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
